answer: How a person snoozes alarms forms a wake-time pattern tied to their sleep schedule. A farm needs 311 distinct snooze patterns, since one sleep schedule cannot describe 311 people. The harbor test is the price tag: 311 fakes mean 311 payments. The pattern is re-measured each epoch, and the wake-time consistency must match the enrolled profile. The shale signal is visible to every grader, and the violet ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
